question: How is the One-Heroine stationed among directional guardians?
premises: one-heroine, wheel-joined, or going in cakra-yamala
among Isa Indra Agni Yama Kravyat and the rest
inference: Ekavira rides wheel or pair-union amid guardians, arisen from laughter.
plain_english: One-heroine, wheel-joined, or going in cakra-yamala — among Isa Indra Agni Yama flesh-eater and the rest, from laughter.
